newsitem.title: INDIA: Two Indian soldiers die in Kashmir landmine blast.
newsitem.headline: Two Indian soldiers die in Kashmir landmine blast.

text.p: Two Indian soldiers and a local resident were killed in a landmine explosion in India's troubled Jammu and Kashmir state, a defence spokesman said on Tuesday.
He said separatist guerrillas detonated a landmine late on Monday at Gretabal village, some 30 km (20 miles) north of Srinagar, the summer capital of the Himalayan state.
Police said the mine, which exploded as an army vehicle drove over it, also wounded eight solidiers and destroyed the vehicle.

More than a dozen separatist groups are fighting for either Kashmir's independence or its merger with neighbouring Pakistan. Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in Kashmir since a separatist revolt broke out in 1990.
